messages.content: Compare the two Richmond hotels with the transportation included. I need to know whether each one actually works for both appointments, not just which room is cheaper.

I can do that. Confirm the appointment locations: Wednesday at 1:30 p.m. is 901 East Byrd Street downtown, and Thursday's 9:00-11:00 a.m. walkthrough is 9101 Arboretum Parkway. Are those still correct?
Yes. The downtown option was the Omni, and the other one was the Hyatt Place near Arboretum. Two nights, Tuesday and Wednesday.

Correct. I have the selected flights as Tuesday, August 12, ORD 6:05 p.m.-RIC 9:18 p.m., and Thursday, August 14, RIC 5:35 p.m.-ORD 6:52 p.m., at $421 round trip. I’ll price both hotels through checkout and compare rideshares and a rental car.
Use rideshare as the main comparison. You can tell me if a car changes the answer, but I don't want parking or a rental omitted from the math.

The Omni Richmond is $199 Tuesday and $209 Wednesday. With $61.20 in taxes and mandatory fees, the complete two-night total is $469.20. It can be canceled without charge through 6:00 p.m. Monday, August 11; after that, the penalty is the full stay.
And the Hyatt?

Hyatt Place Richmond/Arboretum is $154 Tuesday and $159 Wednesday. Taxes bring the complete two-night total to $359.95. That rate is refundable only through 11:59 p.m. Friday, August 8. After that deadline, the full $359.95 is nonrefundable. Your internal meeting schedule is not expected to be final until Monday the 11th, so that deadline arrives before you have confirmation.
That's a real disadvantage. Now lay out the actual trips from each hotel.

From the Omni, Tuesday’s RIC pickup to the hotel is about 18-24 minutes and an estimated $29. On Wednesday, 901 East Byrd Street is an 8-10 minute walk, so no car is needed. Thursday morning, the Omni to 9101 Arboretum Parkway is about 18-25 minutes by I-95 South and VA-150 South, estimated at $33. After the 11:00 walkthrough, Arboretum Parkway to RIC is about 24-32 minutes via VA-150 North, I-95 North, and I-64 East, estimated at $39.
So $101 on transportation from the Omni?

Yes. The estimated rideshare total is $101, with any surge pricing above that. Hotel plus local transportation is $570.20. Adding the selected $421 airfare makes the currently priced trip total $991.20.
What does Thursday look like if I go straight to the airport after the walkthrough?

Leave the walkthrough around 11:00 and expect to reach RIC about 11:30-11:40. That is much earlier than needed for the 5:35 p.m. flight, but it avoids returning downtown and gives you a stable place to work. If you return to the Omni first, you would add roughly $54-$65 in rideshares and should leave downtown for RIC around 3:15.
Keep the direct trip to the airport in the comparison. Now do the Hyatt in the same detail.

Tuesday night, RIC to the Hyatt is about 24-32 minutes and $39. Wednesday, the Hyatt to 901 East Byrd Street is about 20-30 minutes using Midlothian Turnpike and the Downtown Expressway, estimated at $32. Returning to the Hyatt after the meeting is about 22-32 minutes and $35. Thursday morning, the Hyatt to 9101 Arboretum Parkway is 7-10 minutes and about $15. The post-walkthrough trip to RIC is the same 24-32 minutes and approximately $39.
That makes the cheaper hotel $160 in rideshares.

Right. Hyatt lodging plus rideshares is $519.95. With airfare, the trip total is $940.95. It is $50.25 less than the Omni itinerary overall, but Wednesday requires two cross-town rides, roughly 40-62 minutes combined, and the room becomes nonrefundable three days before the schedule is due to be finalized.
Would renting a car make the Hyatt enough cheaper to matter?

No. A compact rental from Tuesday night through Thursday afternoon is $176.40 including taxes, with about $18 for fuel. Hyatt parking is free, but the Wednesday meeting garage is estimated at $18, making local transportation about $212.40. That is $52.40 more than Hyatt rideshares. At the Omni, adding two nights of parking at $40 per night makes the rental-and-fuel total about $274.40, so a car is also worse there.
The Omni is only about fifty dollars more once everything is included, and I can wait until Monday to cancel. Is there any route problem getting to Arboretum by 9 Thursday?

No. A 7:55 a.m. rideshare request should put you in the car by about 8:05 and at Arboretum Parkway around 8:30, leaving approximately 30 minutes of margin. Even with heavier traffic, leaving the Omni by 8:10 should still support a 9:00 start. I would not leave later than 8:15.
Use the Omni as the choice, mainly for Wednesday and the later refund deadline. Keep the Hyatt figures in the record, though. Nothing should be booked until the schedule is final.

Selected without booking: Omni Richmond for Tuesday and Wednesday nights, $469.20 complete, cancelable through 6:00 p.m. Monday, August 11. Estimated rideshares are $29 from RIC to the Omni, no ride for Wednesday’s 8-10 minute walk to 901 East Byrd Street, $33 to the Thursday walkthrough at 9101 Arboretum Parkway, and $39 from the walkthrough to RIC. Local transportation totals $101; with the $421 airfare, the full priced trip is $991.20. Request Thursday’s ride around 7:55 a.m., finish the walkthrough at 11:00, and expect RIC around 11:30-11:40 when traveling directly. The Hyatt remains the alternate at $359.95 for two nights, refundable only through August 8, with $160 in rideshares and a $940.95 trip total. Nothing has been purchased.
